decisions.reason: We would keep this sheet preparation module because it fits directly into our modular automation trajectory and, without clear evidence of lasting failure, another year on the market only deepens our commitment.

We would keep this B2-format multifinisher because it is close to our core portfolio, was publicly highlighted as a strategic flagship, and that visible commitment makes withdrawal especially unlikely.
We would keep this hybrid saddle stitcher because it extends our established booklet-making offer and the launch investment is still easier to justify by continued support than by an early exit.

We would keep this folding add-on unit because it complements existing equipment, has a concrete customer reference, and its modest but clear fit with our installed base supports continued commitment.
